canonicalization.applies_to: reward ties, target ties and pairwise directions
canonicalization.method: round each finite value to 12 decimal places; canonicalize negative zero

contribution_accounting.class_share: for CB, allocate a field's absolute contribution across its gold class keys in proportion to their locked class weights; details unknown is excluded
contribution_accounting.field_share: sum absolute post-normalization semantic contribution by field, divided by the sum across fields; exclude malformed floors and rule adjustment

descriptive_reporting.warning: raw variance is descriptive within a reward only; do not compare its magnitude across the original [0,4] and dense [-1.25,1] scales

metric_contract.group_aggregation: calculate each rate/alignment inside each eligible group, then report mean and median across groups; also report contributing group and pair counts

primary_group_metrics.directional_net_alignment: (concordant - discordant) / target-different pairs; reward ties stay in denominator
primary_group_metrics.harmful_coverage_preference_score: on higher-coverage/lower-known-utility pairs: harmful=1, tie=0.5, safe=0
primary_group_metrics.pairwise_discrimination_rate: non-tied unordered reward pairs divided by 28; average product groups equally

segments.smaller_segments: report support only; do not make directional claims

required: CB replay with class weights replaced by 1.0
CB replay with cap changed from [0.5,2.0] to [0.75,1.5]
metrics stratified by gold-known field count
sensitivity.selection_use: diagnostic only except the locked dominance gates

targets.canonical_known_utility: Candidate U's per-record normalized known-field utility before rule adjustment; the shared correct/partial/abstain/wrong policy target
targets.class_balanced_known_utility: Candidate CB's weighted known semantic score before unknown/rule composition
targets.rule_quality: negative count(rule_violations), so fewer violations is higher
targets.selective_correctness: correct_labels / (scorable_labels - count(false_abstention_labels)); null if denominator zero
targets.unknown_abstention_rate: count(correct_abstention_labels) / count(excluded_gold_unknown_labels); null if no unknown gold

next_step: implement the D3 aggregator against these locked definitions, then open the raw candidate replay records once and publish all candidate results together
role: predeclared D3 metrics, D4 gates and candidate selection hierarchy

selection_boundary.allowed: locked training-only original baseline and raw candidate replay manifest metadata
prohibited: candidate replay record contents or aggregate candidate outcomes

selection_hierarchy.no_passing_candidate: stop Phase D; do not dispatch GPU training
selection_hierarchy.principle: choose the simplest passing policy unless extra semantics earn their complexity

steps.action: discard every candidate that fails any applicable universal gate

steps.comparison: CB versus the surviving uniform candidate
steps.otherwise: prefer the simpler surviving uniform candidate

selection_hierarchy.unresolved_tie: prefer U over UA over CB
selection_hierarchy.winner_claim: offline reward-design selection only, not evidence of policy improvement

uncertainty_contract.multiple_candidates: all three candidates and the selection hierarchy are predeclared; report every comparison
uncertainty_contract.paired_deltas: resample one shared group-index vector and recompute candidate-minus-comparator

universal_acceptance_gates.metric: all lineage checks, deterministic rebuilds and CPU tests
active groups with at least 3 distinct reward levels share
universal_acceptance_gates.rationale: move from a rare 5.3% exception to at least half of groups

universal_acceptance_gates.metric: active groups whose largest reward tie contains at least 6 of 8 completions
universal_acceptance_gates.rationale: reduce the original roughly two-thirds large-tie rate below one-half

universal_acceptance_gates.metric: mean group canonical-known-utility net alignment candidate-minus-original
largest field share of absolute semantic contribution
universal_acceptance_gates.rationale: no field may contribute more than three times the uniform 1/15 share

universal_acceptance_gates.metric: largest gold-class share of absolute known semantic contribution

universal_acceptance_gates.rationale: require an 8.5-point practical reduction from the locked 48.5% baseline
